title: jmap-server: /query and /queryChanges with language (localized sort/filter, queryState, cannotCalculateChanges)
description:
jmap-server: /query and /queryChanges with `language`.
- Sort and filter on a localizable property compare the value /get would return for that `language`, not the base value. This needs the backend query hook to receive the language (decision .1(c)). Memory backends do it.
- When the Comparator has no collation, the backend MAY pick one for the chosen language. Default: keep the current collation.
- queryState encodes the language (decision .1(d)). When the /queryChanges `language` differs from the one in sinceQueryState: cannotCalculateChanges.
Tests: sorting Mailboxes by localized name; a language mismatch on queryChanges.
notes:
Design: docs/design/updates.md (final 2026-11-15, decisions 27-31). QueryParams::language / QueryChangesParams::language (non_exhaustive builder field); backends reporting i18n MUST honour it. queryState wrapper <inner>|lang=<ranges> in the handler, mismatch -> cannotCalculateChanges (decision 28). Only Mailbox, Principal (and later Quota) have /query.
Done 2026-11-15. Deferred to the type beads: the bead's 'sort Mailboxes by localized name' test and memory-backend sort/filter on localized_value need Mailbox locale/localizations (JMAP-cayv.7) and Principal's (JMAP-cayv.9); their custom /query handlers must pass QueryParams::language, wrap queryState with localized_query_state and check sinceQueryState with unwrap_query_state. No collation change by language (MAY, not done).
close_reason: language on /query and /queryChanges: QueryParams/QueryChangesParams::language, queryState wrapper (decision 28), localized_value, generic handler gating; tests
